chunks: And Ismaʿil ibn Abi Ziyad narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:

The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Any free woman who marries herself to a slave without the permission of his masters has made her private part permissible, and there is no dowry for her.”

key_terms.أَبَاحَتْ فَرْجَهَا: made her private part permissible, referring to unlawful sexual exposure through an invalid contract
key_terms.إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ: the permission of his masters or owners
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ حُرَّةٍ: a free woman, meaning one who is not enslaved
key_terms.زَوَّجَتْ نَفْسَهَا: married herself, i.e. contracted marriage for herself
key_terms.صَدَاقَ: dowry owed to the wife in marriage

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a free woman marries a slave without the permission of his masters?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the invalidity of a marriage involving a slave when it is contracted without the permission of his masters. It states that such a union does not establish the woman's entitlement to dowry and addresses the legal consequences of an unauthorized marriage contract.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4555 - Ismail ibn Abi Ziyad narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his forefathers (peace be upon them) that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Any free woman who marries herself to a slave without the permission of his masters has made her private parts permissible unlawfully, and she is not entitled to a dowry."
